item.title: Court delays ruling in Ganduje port case
item.description: A Kano High Court has postponed proceedings in the case involving former governor, Abdullahi Ganduje over the ownership of a multi-billion-naira inland port project. Ganduje and three others are facing 10 charges, including criminal conspiracy, misuse of public funds, breach of trust, and conflict of interest. item.title: Okpebholo condemns attack on ADC members, blames internal party rift
item.description: Governor Monday Okpebholo of Edo State has issued a firm condemnation of the recent assault on members of the African Democratic Congress, ADC, characterizing the incident as an escalation of internal party conflict that has gone excessively far. In a personal statement released on Tuesday evening, the governor expressed sympathy for the affected party members. […] Okpebholo condemns attack on ADC members, blames internal party rift

item.title: Taraba PDP crisis deepens as state leadership rejects factional caretaker committee
item.description: The internal crisis rocking the Peoples Democratic Party, PDP, in Taraba State has intensified following the rejection of a 16-member caretaker committee constituted by a faction of the party’s National Caretaker Working Committee. item.title: Ukraine: Russia threatens UK, France over nuclear weapons supply
item.description: Russia has vowed to take retaliatory actions if Ukraine strikes any part of its territory with nuclear arms purportedly from the United Kingdom and France. Russia’s Foreign Intelligence Service, SVR, claimed on Tuesday that the British and French authorities plan to “disguise the transfer of nuclear weapons to Kyiv as Ukraine’s own development.” The SVR […] Ukraine: Russia threatens UK, France over nuclear weapons supply

item.title: Russia probes Telegram founder, Pavel Durov for ‘aiding terrorism’
item.description: ​Russia has launched a probe of Telegram founder, Pavel Durov for allegedly abetting terrorist activities, following the breakdown in talks with the tech billionaire.
